purpose: Create a new Git branch with timestamp-based naming and sync it with the remote repository.
instructions: Create a new branch with format: YYYY.MM.DD.HHMM-feature-description (e.g., 2025.12.08.1409-feature-cleanup)
Use git checkout -b <branch-name> to create and switch to the new branch
Push the branch to remote with tracking: git push -u origin <branch-name>
Verify branch is synced: git branch --show-current and git branch -r

naming_convention.description: Timestamp (year.month.day.hourminute) followed by feature description in kebab-case

warnings: Ensure you are on the correct base branch before creating a new branch
Verify remote repository connection before pushing
Use descriptive branch names that clearly indicate the feature or fix
